deviations_from_flop: Token LM, gamma1 pertoken, shared critic trunk, priorSFT and retention,20%empty starts, first-proof retention rather than replacement; not an exact reproduction.
estimand: Incremental effect of admitting own discovered target proofs to backward curricula under a common EMA/TD/entropy continuation package. Difference from primary endpoint also changes common settings and is not a pure TD or EMA effect.
final_selection: All declared endpoints, with no best-checkpoint selection.
inference: Same unaided primary512-token greedy/4sample profiles; structured1024-token profiles.
initial_bank: First strictly verified full-start target proof from the corresponding completed primary run, hash-bound to checkpoint and raw attempts; long online certificates allowed, external certificates remain cap6.
initialization_rule: Use both predeclared primary PPO-reset final endpoints, one per primary training seed; never select by development performance.
optimizer: Saved policy+critic, fresh matched Adam and RNG per on/off pair; source curriculum restarts near end.
